description: This file contains client-side utility functions for interacting with a backend API, including fetching module data, overview metrics, and handling API URL resolution. It defines functions for fetching JSON data, resolving the base API URL, and exporting key API interaction functions such as getModules and getOverviewMetrics.

methods.name: resolveBase()
methods.description: Resolves the base URL for API calls, first trying a heuristic via getApiBase, then falling back to window location or localhost.

methods.name: fetchJson(url, { credentials = 'omit' } = {})
methods.description: Performs a fetch request expecting JSON or text, handles errors, and appends organization_id query parameter if available.

methods.name: toArray(data)
methods.description: Converts various data shapes into an array for consistent processing.

methods.name: getModules()
methods.description: Fetches a list of modules or derives a minimal overview if endpoints are unavailable.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics()
methods.description: Fetches consolidated dashboard metrics such as total users and deployed applications.
